name: Claude for Startups API Credits
free_limit: Early-stage startup founders can apply to be considered for one-time first-party Claude API credits and priority rate limits. Anthropic does not promise a public fixed credit amount for each applicant.
watch_out: General founder community access does not guarantee free credits. Claude credits/extras require qualifying institutional equity funding, company age within four years and no previous Anthropic startup credits; an Anthropic/Claude Console account, company email and site are required. Credits are not valid for AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI; standard API billing applies after the program credit is exhausted.
